[[Duck Hunt Event|Duck Hunt]] |first_wave_appearance = 3 ([[Duck Hunt Event|Duck Hunt]]) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]6Beyond wave 10, '''Cool Ducky''' scaled its health with time. |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Fast (5.5) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |ability1 = |spawned_by = [[Eggroll]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Cool Ducky''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[D00M's Revenge]] as part of the [[Duck Hunt Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned again in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It had low health, but a slightly fast speed. Beyond wave 10, its health would increase over time. The '''Cool Ducky''' could be spawned by the [[Eggroll]]. ==Appearance== The '''Cool Ducky''' is a yellow duck with black eyes and an orange beak. It has a black, white and orange cap, as well as black and white shoes. It rides on a black and orange skateboard with yellow wheels. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[D00M's Revenge]] is listed instead. *Cheap towers like the [[Soldier]] and [[Golden Scout]] fare well against the '''Cool Ducky'''. **Multiple Level 1 [[Sniper]]s are recommended for their long range. In addition, the [[Sniper]] can also counter the [[Flying Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Flying Ducky]] that debuts later on in the game. *As many of these spawn, towers that can damage multiple enemies at once, like the [[Executioner]], can clear out hordes of this enemy. **Like the [[Sniper]], the [[Executioner]] can counter the [[Flying Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Flying Ducky]]. Do be aware that its hidden detection is too expensive to deal with [[Spy Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Spy Duckies]], a hidden enemy that debuts later on in the game. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyCoolDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Spring Trailer|'''Cool Ducky''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyCoolDuckyIconIG.png|'''Cool Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''17 April 2022''' - [[v1.2.0]] **'''Cool Ducky''' added. *'''28 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]] **'''Cool Ducky''' removed. *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Cool Ducky''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Cool Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Cool Ducky]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Ducky Revenge Event]]. ==Notes== {{D00MRevenge|[[Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Ducky]]|Wave 1|Cool Ducky|Wave 3|[[Fat Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Fat Ducky]]|Wave 5}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Cool Ducky}}
